meanings.note: Of glass or a cup. Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'биться'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to crash, to get killed (in a fall/crash); to break', paired with 'разбиваться'.
